paraphrases: Inspect the database before writing anything after this uncertain handoff.
Read the persisted state first. Then carry out the remaining operations.
Before any write, check what the database already contains.
Start by inspecting the current records to learn which writes are needed.
First read the database to see if the earlier operation took effect.
Check the stored state before retrying an operation with a lost acknowledgement.
Use the inspect action first and base subsequent writes on its result.
After an uncertain write, look at the database before changing it again.
Inspect before modifying data so that a completed operation runs only once.
Read the live records before deciding whether the previous write must be repeated.
